agent_output.affected_group: Participants in and managers of the Northeast skate complex fishery (seven skate species off the New England and mid-Atlantic coasts) managed under the Northeast Skate Complex FMP by the New England Fishery Management Council / NMFS
agent_output.change_summary: Notice of availability of proposed Amendment 8 to the Northeast Skate Complex Fishery Management Plan, submitted by the New England Fishery Management Council to NMFS for review/approval. The amendment would revise FMP management Objectives 2 and 5 (unchanged since 2003). The action is explicitly administrative, with no changes to regulatory text or specific management measures; NMFS requests public comments by May 31, 2022 before deciding whether to approve or disapprove.

evidence.quote:
The New England Fishery Management Council has submitted 
Amendment 8 to the Northeast Skate Complex Fishery Management Plan to 
NMFS for review and approval. Amendment 8 would update the objectives 
of the skate fishery management plan, which have been unchanged since 
the original plan was adopted in 2003.

This is an administrative amendment that contains no changes to the 
regulatory text or specific management measures of the Northeast skate 
fishery. However, NMFS will still decide whether to approve these 
recommended changes to the central objectives of the FMP that guide and 
inform management decisions.

The New England Fishery Management Council manages a complex of 
seven skate species (barndoor, clearnose, little, rosette, smooth, 
thorny, and winter skate) off the New England and mid-Atlantic coasts 
under the Northeast Skate Complex Fishery Management Plan (FMP).

ACTION: Notice of availability of proposed fishery management plan 
amendment; request for comments.
DATES: Comments must be received on or before May 31, 2022.
